title: Secure first confirmed consumer/partner
context: A confirmed consumer is what proves per-output delivery need, flipping verifiedNeed to true. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access (PMC OA Subset) / aggregate / de-identified data only; no identifiable patient data; no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. This task secures the first named consumer and documents how they will ingest the corpus.
objective: Secure and document the first confirmed consumer/partner for the corpus.
acceptanceCriteria: A named consumer (KG maintainer or external lab/advocacy) confirms they will use the corpus.
Consumption mechanism documented (repo ingestion / DOI / direct handoff).
Tasks for that consumer updated to verifiedNeed: true with requestor set.
